title: Query count of the depth-two evaluation tree
statement: Choose a block and a seed from a three-element set, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^9$. The depth-two evaluation decision tree queries exactly two coordinates when the chosen block of $x$ has equal values at the cyclic first and second coordinates determined by the seed, and exactly three coordinates otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: input $x$ is a sign vector of length $9$
